terminology_decisions: GameHQ, GameInput, XInput, DualSense, HDR, FPS, Steam, Playnite, GitHub, SHA-256, HTTPS, NTFS, ReFS, GDI, PNG, JPEG, executable names, paths, switches, URLs and placeholders remain untranslated.
A saved screenshot or video item is запись; the act of capturing is захват, and binding detection never reuses the media term.
replay is повтор, buffer is буфер, clip is клип, recording is запись.
overlay is оверлей, gallery is галерея, library is библиотека, sidebar is боковая панель, tray is трей.
binding is привязка, assignment is назначение, slot is слот, gesture is жест, hold is удержание, press is нажатие, and release-based tap is одиночное нажатие.
controller is геймпад throughout the product, matching Russian gaming convention rather than контроллер.
Update security vocabulary is fixed: manifest is манифест, checksum is контрольная сумма, signature is подпись, staging is подготовка, transaction is транзакция, trust state is состояние доверия.
portable is портативный, staged is подготовленный, journal is журнал, schema is схема, folder is папка, and the portable scheme prefix stays literal.
Key and button names such as Enter, Esc, Delete, Share, View, Guide and PS stay untranslated; DualSense face buttons are Крест, Круг, Квадрат and Треугольник.
Buttons and action labels use the Russian infinitive; directional actions use Перейти; errors and warnings stay impersonal complete sentences.
calibration_rules: Review every stable ID with its English source, source location, control role and neighboring UI; schema validity is not linguistic evidence.
Prefer established Russian product terminology over literal English syntax, but preserve protected technical names.
Use Russian quotation marks and punctuation, and keep syntax tokens, placeholders and accelerators intact.
Reject machine-like phrasing even when structurally valid, including subtitle artefacts, truncated clauses and second-person dialogue.
Keep control labels concise; keep errors and warnings as natural complete sentences.
Resolve units made stale by the accepted English QA from the new English meaning, never from the superseded Russian wording.
Check all three Russian plural forms against the numerus source rather than assuming a single form.
